verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's own Entity Management API returns entity data, including a user's own registration looked up by UEI, in open JSON or CSV formats. It also offers an API Extract for bulk retrieval. However, this is a public or tiered data API rather than a documented personal export of 'all of my data', and nothing in the evidence covers leaving the service. Missing for 10: a documented full personal or account data export covering workspace, saved searches and submissions; account deletion or offboarding; independent or hands-on corroboration; relief from the 1,000,000-record cap.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: It returns data in the JSON or CSV format as selected by the user. It can return only the first 1,000,000 records.
